name: appilabs
description: AppiLabs platform: React + Vite frontend, Express (ES modules) + MongoDB backend, Python automation.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
